title: New Features for Report Lifecycle Management in Business Central 28.1
summary: Business Central 28.1 introduces report layout lifecycle management with status tracking. The Report Layouts page now supports Draft, Pending Approval, Approved, and Retired statuses, allowing developers to manage report layout versions without exposing incomplete versions to end users.
key_points: Report layouts now have status states: Draft, Pending Approval, Approved, and Retired
Only Approved layouts are visible to end users; others remain hidden
Draft and Pending Approval statuses allow developers to test layouts from the Report Layouts screen
Layout status can be changed via the Actions menu without creating new sandboxes
Retired status hides old layouts while keeping new versions available

quotes.text: Business Central 28.1 adds a new feature to report management allowing for a lifecycle process around report layouts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core capability being introduced that solves the challenge of managing report layout versions across development and production environments.
